Comment: IS459 G2T1 AML pipeline: ingest external rates, crawl, ETL, BQ1 and BQ2 in parallel. Pass states are placeholders until teammates' jobs exist.

FetchRates.Comment: Role 1: Lambda pulls ECB FX and Coinbase BTC into s3://is459-g2t1-aml-bucket/fx and /btc

StartRatesCrawler.Comment: Role 1: refresh raw_fx and raw_btc tables

ETL_TransactionsClean.Comment: Role 2: Glue job builds transactions_clean (Parquet) and updates the catalog. Fails on purpose if data quality checks fail.

Analytics.Comment: BQ1 corridors, BQ1 graph (Role 4) and BQ2 run in parallel once transactions_clean exists

BQ1_ResetOutputs.Comment: Role 1 helper: drop the 4 BQ1 tables and empty their S3 folders so CTAS can rerun

BQ1_Step1_and_2a.Comment: Role 3: steps 1 and 2a are independent, run together

BQ1_DirectCorridors.Comment: Role 3 step 1: direct cross-bank corridor totals

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_direct_corridors
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_direct_corridors/'
) AS
SELECT
  from_bank,
  to_bank,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_laundering = 1 THEN amount_paid_usd ELSE 0 END) AS direct_laundered_usd,
  SUM(amount_paid_usd) AS direct_total_usd,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN is_laundering = 1 THEN 1 END) AS direct_laundering_txns,
  COUNT(*) AS direct_total_txns
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium'
  AND cross_bank = 1
  AND amount_paid_usd < 20000000
GROUP BY from_bank, to_bank

BQ1_AttemptBanks.Comment: Role 3 step 2a: per-attempt totals and banks touched

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_attempt_banks
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_attempt_banks/'
) AS
SELECT
  attempt_id,
  SUM(amount_paid_usd) AS attempt_total_usd,
  ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT from_bank) || ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT to_bank)) AS banks_touched
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium'
  AND is_laundering = 1
  AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL
  AND amount_paid_usd < 20000000
GROUP BY attempt_id

BQ1_SharedAttemptValue.Comment: Role 3 step 2b: shared attempt value per bank pair

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_shared_attempt_value
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_shared_attempt_value/'
) AS
SELECT
  a.bank_x AS from_bank,
  b.bank_y AS to_bank,
  SUM(t.attempt_total_usd) AS shared_attempt_value_usd
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_attempt_banks t
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.banks_touched) AS a(bank_x)
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.banks_touched) AS b(bank_y)
WHERE a.bank_x != b.bank_y
GROUP BY a.bank_x, b.bank_y

BQ1_CorridorsRanked.Comment: Role 3 step 3: final ranked corridors (extra laundering value, blindspot gap)

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_corridors_ranked
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_corridors_ranked/'
) AS
SELECT
  d.from_bank,
  d.to_bank,
  d.direct_laundered_usd,
  COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) AS total_laundering_in_path_usd,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) - d.direct_laundered_usd, 0) AS extra_laundering_value_usd,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) > 0
    THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) - d.direct_laundered_usd, 0)
         / CAST(s.shared_attempt_value_usd AS DOUBLE)
    ELSE 0 END AS blindspot_gap
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_direct_corridors d
LEFT JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_shared_attempt_value s
  ON d.from_bank = s.from_bank AND d.to_bank = s.to_bank

Graph_Init.Comment: Role 4: fresh run ID per execution (runner rejects reused IDs)

Graph_StartInstance.Comment: Only starts the instance if it was stopped; remembers this so it is stopped again afterwards

Graph_WaitForNeo4j.Comment: Fresh boot: give Docker/Neo4j time to start before the runner connects

Graph_RunGraph.Comment: Role 4: run the graph runner via her SSM document

Graph_ReadReceipt.Comment: Validate the run-specific success.json the runner publishes last

Graph_UpdateLatestView.Comment: Stable name for Role 3 / Tableau: points at this run's validated feature table

Parameters.QueryString.$: States.Format('CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_graph_bank_features_latest AS SELECT * FROM {}', $.graph.receipt.receipt.feature_table)

Graph_CleanupOnFailure.Comment: On any failure: stop the instance only if this run started it

Graph_Failed.Cause: Role 4 graph run failed: see the failed step, SSM command output, or bq1_graph_results/<runId>/ in S3

BQ2_ResetOutputs.Comment: Role 5: drop bq2_sequences and empty its S3 folder before the rebuild

BQ2_CreateTable.Comment: Role 5: create the empty partitioned table (v1 schema) so the days can load in parallel

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  write_compression = 'SNAPPY',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq2_sequences/',
  partitioned_by = ARRAY['dataset', 'start_date']
) AS
WITH
ta AS (
  SELECT txn_id, txn_ts, from_bank, from_account, to_bank, to_account,
         payment_format, payment_currency, receiving_currency, is_laundering,
         date_diff('day', DATE '2022-08-01', CAST(txn_date AS date)) AS day_idx
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
  WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND txn_date BETWEEN '2022-09-01' AND '2022-09-01'
),
tb AS (
  SELECT txn_id, txn_ts, from_bank, from_account, to_bank, to_account,
         payment_format, payment_currency, receiving_currency, is_laundering,
         date_diff('day', DATE '2022-08-01', CAST(txn_date AS date)) AS day_idx
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
  WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND txn_date BETWEEN '2022-09-01' AND '2022-09-02'
),
hop_a AS (
  SELECT ta.txn_id AS a_id, ta.txn_ts AS a_ts, ta.payment_format AS a_m, ta.payment_currency AS a_pc, ta.receiving_currency AS a_rc, ta.is_laundering AS a_l, ta.to_bank AS a_to_bank, ta.to_account AS a_to_account, ta.day_idx AS a_day FROM ta
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT h.*, tb.txn_id AS b_id, tb.txn_ts AS b_ts, tb.payment_format AS b_m, tb.payment_currency AS b_pc, tb.receiving_currency AS b_rc, tb.is_laundering AS b_l, tb.to_bank AS b_to_bank, tb.to_account AS b_to_account, tb.day_idx AS b_day
  FROM hop_a h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[h.a_day, h.a_day + 1]) AS k(key_day)
  JOIN tb ON tb.from_bank = h.a_to_bank AND tb.from_account = h.a_to_account AND tb.day_idx = k.key_day AND tb.txn_ts > h.a_ts AND tb.txn_ts <= h.a_ts + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  WHERE tb.txn_id <> h.a_id
),
chains AS (SELECT * FROM pairs)
SELECT
  lower(to_hex(sha256(to_utf8('v1' || chr(10) || 'HI-Medium' || chr(10) || CAST(a_id AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(b_id AS varchar))))) AS sequence_id,
  'v1' AS rule_version,
  CAST(2 AS integer) AS sequence_length,
  ARRAY[a_id, b_id] AS txn_ids,
  ARRAY[a_ts, b_ts] AS txn_timestamps,
  ARRAY[a_m, b_m] AS payment_methods,
  a_m || ' -> ' || b_m AS method_sequence,
  ARRAY[a_pc, b_pc] AS payment_currencies,
  ARRAY[a_rc, b_rc] AS receiving_currencies,
  a_pc || ' -> ' || b_pc AS payment_currency_sequence,
  a_rc || ' -> ' || b_rc AS receiving_currency_sequence,
  ARRAY[a_l, b_l] AS txn_laundering_labels,
  CAST(a_l + b_l AS integer) AS laundering_count,
  CASE WHEN a_l + b_l > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_laundering,
  CASE WHEN a_l + b_l = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_laundering,
  b_id AS final_txn_id,
  b_l AS final_is_laundering,
  ARRAY[date_diff('second', a_ts, b_ts)] AS gap_seconds,
  date_diff('second', a_ts, b_ts) AS duration_seconds,
  'HI-Medium' AS dataset,
  date_format(a_ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date
FROM chains
WITH NO DATA

INSERT INTO is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences
WITH
ta AS (
  SELECT txn_id, txn_ts, from_bank, from_account, to_bank, to_account,
         payment_format, payment_currency, receiving_currency, is_laundering,
         date_diff('day', DATE '2022-08-01', CAST(txn_date AS date)) AS day_idx
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
  WHERE dataset = 'LI-Medium' AND txn_date BETWEEN '2022-09-27' AND '2022-09-27'
),
tb AS (
  SELECT txn_id, txn_ts, from_bank, from_account, to_bank, to_account,
         payment_format, payment_currency, receiving_currency, is_laundering,
         date_diff('day', DATE '2022-08-01', CAST(txn_date AS date)) AS day_idx
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
  WHERE dataset = 'LI-Medium' AND txn_date BETWEEN '2022-09-27' AND '2022-09-28'
),
hop_a AS (
  SELECT ta.txn_id AS a_id, ta.txn_ts AS a_ts, ta.payment_format AS a_m, ta.payment_currency AS a_pc, ta.receiving_currency AS a_rc, ta.is_laundering AS a_l, ta.to_bank AS a_to_bank, ta.to_account AS a_to_account, ta.day_idx AS a_day FROM ta
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT h.*, tb.txn_id AS b_id, tb.txn_ts AS b_ts, tb.payment_format AS b_m, tb.payment_currency AS b_pc, tb.receiving_currency AS b_rc, tb.is_laundering AS b_l, tb.to_bank AS b_to_bank, tb.to_account AS b_to_account, tb.day_idx AS b_day
  FROM hop_a h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[h.a_day, h.a_day + 1]) AS k(key_day)
  JOIN tb ON tb.from_bank = h.a_to_bank AND tb.from_account = h.a_to_account AND tb.day_idx = k.key_day AND tb.txn_ts > h.a_ts AND tb.txn_ts <= h.a_ts + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  WHERE tb.txn_id <> h.a_id
),
tc AS (
  SELECT txn_id, txn_ts, from_bank, from_account, to_bank, to_account,
         payment_format, payment_currency, receiving_currency, is_laundering,
         date_diff('day', DATE '2022-08-01', CAST(txn_date AS date)) AS day_idx
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
  WHERE dataset = 'LI-Medium' AND txn_date BETWEEN '2022-09-27' AND '2022-09-29'
),
chains AS (
  SELECT p.*, tc.txn_id AS c_id, tc.txn_ts AS c_ts, tc.payment_format AS c_m, tc.payment_currency AS c_pc, tc.receiving_currency AS c_rc, tc.is_laundering AS c_l, tc.to_bank AS c_to_bank, tc.to_account AS c_to_account, tc.day_idx AS c_day
  FROM pairs p
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[p.b_day, p.b_day + 1]) AS k(key_day)
  JOIN tc ON tc.from_bank = p.b_to_bank AND tc.from_account = p.b_to_account AND tc.day_idx = k.key_day AND tc.txn_ts > p.b_ts AND tc.txn_ts <= p.b_ts + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  WHERE tc.txn_id <> p.a_id AND tc.txn_id <> p.b_id
)
SELECT
  lower(to_hex(sha256(to_utf8('v1' || chr(10) || 'LI-Medium' || chr(10) || CAST(a_id AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(b_id AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(c_id AS varchar))))) AS sequence_id,
  'v1' AS rule_version,
  CAST(3 AS integer) AS sequence_length,
  ARRAY[a_id, b_id, c_id] AS txn_ids,
  ARRAY[a_ts, b_ts, c_ts] AS txn_timestamps,
  ARRAY[a_m, b_m, c_m] AS payment_methods,
  a_m || ' -> ' || b_m || ' -> ' || c_m AS method_sequence,
  ARRAY[a_pc, b_pc, c_pc] AS payment_currencies,
  ARRAY[a_rc, b_rc, c_rc] AS receiving_currencies,
  a_pc || ' -> ' || b_pc || ' -> ' || c_pc AS payment_currency_sequence,
  a_rc || ' -> ' || b_rc || ' -> ' || c_rc AS receiving_currency_sequence,
  ARRAY[a_l, b_l, c_l] AS txn_laundering_labels,
  CAST(a_l + b_l + c_l AS integer) AS laundering_count,
  CASE WHEN a_l + b_l + c_l > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_laundering,
  CASE WHEN a_l + b_l + c_l = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_laundering,
  c_id AS final_txn_id,
  c_l AS final_is_laundering,
  ARRAY[date_diff('second', a_ts, b_ts), date_diff('second', b_ts, c_ts)] AS gap_seconds,
  date_diff('second', a_ts, c_ts) AS duration_seconds,
  'LI-Medium' AS dataset,
  date_format(a_ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date
FROM chains
